description: This file is a Python module implementing a parser for Kickstart files, including classes for handling sections, scripts, certificates, and the parsing state machine.

classes.name: Certificate
classes.description: Represents a single %certificate section in a Kickstart file.

classes.name: Script
classes.description: Represents a single %pre, %pre-install, %post, or %traceback script in a Kickstart file.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a group in the %packages section.

classes.name: Packages
classes.description: Represents the %packages section of a Kickstart file.

classes.name: KickstartParser
classes.description: Implements the state machine for parsing Kickstart files.

classes.name: PutBackIterator
classes.description: Iterator wrapper that allows putting back a line for re-processing.

methods.name: _preprocessStateMachine
methods.description: Processes lines for %ksappend directives, fetching remote files if needed.

methods.name: preprocessFromStringToString
methods.description: Preprocesses a Kickstart string, handling %ksappend lines, returns complete file as string.

methods.name: preprocessKickstartToString
methods.description: Preprocesses a Kickstart file given by filename, returns complete file as string.

methods.name: preprocessFromString
methods.description: Preprocesses a Kickstart string, returns filename of processed file.

methods.name: preprocessKickstart
methods.description: Preprocesses a Kickstart file given by filename, returns filename of processed file.

methods.name: readKickstartFromString
methods.description: Processes a Kickstart file provided as a string.

methods.name: readKickstart
methods.description: Processes a Kickstart file given by filename.

methods.name: setupSections
methods.description: Initializes the sections supported by the parser.
